title: 第6章 唯心主义的复兴与回应

zh: 第6章 唯心主义的复兴与回应
en: Chapter 6: IDEALIST REPRISE AND RESPONSES

zh: 对玻尔兹曼的反对
玻尔兹曼职业生涯大部分时间作为物理学家度过。然而，他生命最后几年是在维也纳大学担任哲学教授。在这个职位上，他接替了同样身兼物理学与哲学双重身份的马赫。
en: Boltzmann spent a large part of his career as a physicist. His final years, though, were as the professor of philosophy at the University of Vienna. In this post, he replaced Mach, who also straddled physics and philosophy.

zh: 无论在哲学还是物理学领域，两人都是对手，各自主张截然相反立场。作为唯物主义原子论者的玻尔兹曼，与作为唯心主义者的马赫针锋相对。
en: In terms both of philosophy and physics the two were rivals, proponents of polar opposite positions. Boltzmann, the materialist atomist, against Mach, the idealist.

zh: 尽管如今玻尔兹曼的原子论已完全没有争议，但在他生前却远非如此。许多欧洲大陆的著名物理学家都对原子的存在深表怀疑。例如，庞加莱把玻尔兹曼、汤姆森和麦克斯韦提出的关于热的原子论解释称为“英国
动理论”，并怀疑它能否解释熵增定律。
en: Although Boltzmann’s atomism is now completely uncontroversial, that was far from the case in his lifetime. A lot of prominent continental physicists were highly sceptical about the existence of atoms. Poincaré, for example, referred to the atomistic account of heat propounded by Boltzmann, Thomson and Maxwell as the ‘English
kinetic theory’ and doubted it as an explanation of the law of increasing entropy.

zh: 我不知道是否有人指出过，英国的这些动理论能够摆脱这一矛盾。按照这些理论，世界最初趋向于一种状态，并长久停留其中而不发生明显变化；这与经验相符。但如果不违背上述定理，世界就不会永远保持这种状态；它只会停留极其漫长的时间，分子越多，这段时间就越长。这种状态并非宇宙的最终死亡，而是一种沉睡，宇宙将在百万乘百万个世纪之后从中苏醒。按照这种理论，要看到热从冷物体传向热物体，并不需要麦克斯韦妖那样敏锐的视力、智慧和灵巧；稍有耐心便足够了。
en: I do not know if it has been remarked that the English kinetic theories can extricate themselves from this contradiction. The world, according to them, tends at first toward a state where it remains for a long time without apparent change; and this is consistent with experience; but it does not remain that way forever, if the theorem cited above is not violated; it merely stays there for an enormously long time, a time which is longer the more numerous are the molecules. This state will not be the final death of the universe, but a sort of slumber, from which it will awake after millions of millions of centuries. According to this theory, to see heat pass from a cold body to a warm one, it will not be necessary to have the acute vision, the intelligence, and dexterity of Maxwell’s demon; it will suffice to have a little patience.

zh: 庞加莱对原子论的反对建立在严格的数学异议之上。这些异议源于抽象的拉格朗日力学或哈密顿力学，而非哲学或本体论。实质上，他利用刘维尔定理，把汤姆森在前引段落中给出的启发式解释转化为形式化的数学论证。由此可以证明：在时刻
，取
维相空间内的一个微小体积
，使其沿最小作用量路径演化一个很短的时间
，它就会映射到相空间中的一个新区域
，而体积保持不变。因此，他认为，若从处于某一低熵状态的封闭系统出发，即从只占相空间中可能位置的一小部分的某个

出发，最后总会落到一个等体积的区域。也就是说，所得相空间体积同样不大可能出现。策梅洛也提出了类似论证。这些论证依赖于一个看似必然的结论：任何按确定性规律运行的有限粒子系统都会发生回归。对格子气例子那样简单且规模较小的模型，这一点当然成立；但如果宇宙无限——这实质上是汤姆森的观点——或者即使体积不大的气体，其回归也需要漫长得多的时间，以至于我们不妨把系统视为无限——这是玻尔兹曼的回应——那么这一论证便不能成立。
en: The opposition to atomism by Poincaré was founded on strictly mathematical objections. They were ones founded on abstract Lagrangian or Hamiltonian mechanics rather than philosophy or ontology. In essence, he translated the heuristic explanation given by Thomson in the passages quoted earlier into formal maths using Liouville theorem. This can be used to show that if you take a small volume
in a 6N dimensional phase space at time
and allow it to evolve along a course of least action for some small time
it maps to a new region in phase space
whose volume is unchanged. Thus he argued that if you start with a closed system in some low-entropy state, that is, in some

that is a small part of the possible phase space positions, it will always end up in an equivalent volume. That is to say, the resultant volume of phase space is equally improbable, while similar arguments were being made by Zermelo. They rested on the apparent necessity for recurrences to occur in any finite system of particles operating by deterministic laws. While this is certainly valid for simple relatively small models like our lattice gas example, the argument fell if either the universe is infinite – which was essentially Thomsons point – or that such recurrences would take such a long time for even modest volumes of gas, that we might as well treat the system as infinite – Boltzmann’s response.

zh: 因此，当策梅洛仅凭“气体中初始状态必然会重现”这一理论事实——却未计算这将耗时多久——便得出“必须摒弃气体理论的假设，否则就必须对其进行根本性修改”结论时，他就像一个掷骰子的人：他计算出连续掷出1000 个“1”概率不为零，却尚未观察到这样序列，就断定自己骰子必定是做过手脚！
en: Thus when Zermelo concludes, from the theoretical fact that the initial states in a gas must recur – without having calculated how long a time this will take –, that the hypotheses of gas theory must be rejected or else fundamentally changed, he is just like a dice player who has calculated that the probability of a sequence of 1000 one’s is not zero, and then concludes that his dice must be loaded since he has not yet observed such a sequence!

zh: 庞加莱回归论证中还隐含着这样一个假设：在所有时刻，原子位置都是以任意精度客观确定。如果放弃这一假设，如果我们允许原子位置存在任何绝对、客观不确定性，那么碰撞过程就会放大这种初始不确定性程度。
en: There is also an implicit assumption in the Poincaré reccurence argument that the positions of the atoms are objectively defined to arbitrary precision at all instants. If this is abandoned, if we allow for any absolute, objective uncertainty in the positions of atoms, then the collision process magnifies the scale of that initial uncertainty.

zh: 我们此前
在讨论弗雷德金假设的可逆计算机
时谈过这个问题；在某种意义上，这些计算机是庞加莱论证的一种变体。用我们稍后将讨论的现代信息论来说，假定粒子位置具有任意精度，就意味着系统包含无限的信息，从而在相空间中占据零体积。由于熵以相空间体积的对数来定义，而
没有定义，策梅洛／庞加莱回归悖论的概念设定本身就使熵的概念失去了意义。
en: We have discussed this earlier
in our treatment of Fredkin’s hypothetical reversible computers

which are in a sense a variant of the Poincaré argument. In terms of modern information theory, which we will discuss later, the assumption of arbitrarily precise particle positions implies a system with infinite information content and thus a zero volume in phase space. Since entropy is defined in terms of a logarithm over volumes in phase space, and since log(0) is an undefined function, the very conceptual setup of the Zermelo/Poincaré recurrence paradox renders the concept of entropy meaningless.

zh: 人们要么像庞加莱那样得出结论：原子论和“英国动理论”是错误的；要么认为经典分析所假设关于位置任意精度数学是不符合物理实际。随后几十年量子力学发展指向了后一种结论。如果位置不能被任意分割，那么虽然仍可以存在如前所述格子模型等确定性模型，但原则上也可能存在非确定性格子模型。
en: One either concludes, as Poincaré did, that atomism and the ‘English kinetic theory’ are false or that the arbitrary precision mathematics of position assumed by classical analysis is unphysical. The development of quantum mechanics in subsequent decades pointed to the latter conclusion. If positions are not arbitrarily divisible, then you can still have deterministic models like the lattice models presented earlier, but you could, in principle, also have non-deterministic lattice models.

zh: 马赫主义

玻尔兹曼生命最后几年，都耗费在看来可能是一场徒劳斗争上——试图说服德语科学界接受他的原子理论。除了前文提到批评者外，马赫这一显赫人物也与他针锋相对。马赫在1901 年之前一直担任维也纳大学哲学教授，他宣扬反原子论和反实在论哲学思想，对一代欧洲科学家产生了深远影响。他的哲学立场在当今关于量子力学诠释争论中依然回响不绝。1901 年马赫退休后，玻尔兹曼接替他担任维也纳大学哲学教授席位，并开始讲授科学哲学。遗憾的是，他的任期很短。
en: The final years of Boltzmann’s life were consumed by what likely felt like a futile struggle to persuade the German-speaking scientific community to embrace his atomic theories. In addition to previously mentioned critics, the prominent figure of Mach stood against him. Mach, a professor of Philosophy at Vienna until 1901, propagated anti-atomistic and anti-realist philosophies that greatly impacted a generation of European scientists. His philosophical stance still resonates in today’s debates on quantum mechanics interpretations. Following Mach’s retirement in 1901, Boltzmann succeeded him as the Chair of Philosophy at Vienna, where he began teaching the philosophy of science. Sadly, his tenure was brief.

zh: 1906 年9 月6 日，他与妻子和女儿一同前往的里雅斯特附近杜伊诺湾游玩。当妻子和女儿正在享受游泳之乐时，他上吊自杀了。此前他在莱比锡时曾有过一次自杀未遂。当得知深陷抑郁玻尔兹曼自杀身亡消息时，世界各地物理学家都深感悲痛。许多物理学家难以理解他这一举动。他的自杀似乎更多源于个人生活中因素（抑郁症和健康状况恶化），而非任何学术问题。在抑郁和健康状况不佳情况下，他就在实验即将验证其研究成果之际自杀了。奥斯特瓦尔德在悼念玻尔兹曼时，把他描述为那些为科学真理而奋斗人们所必须付出巨大健康与精力牺牲的牺牲品。一些物理学家则把玻尔兹曼自杀归因于精神不稳定。据钱德拉塞卡所述，奥斯特瓦尔德和马赫对其理论猛烈抨击使他深陷抑郁，这促使他自杀。
en: With his wife and daughter he visited a place at the Bay of Duino near Trieste on September 6, 1906. When his wife and daughter were enjoying swimming he hanged himself. He had made an earlier suicide attempt when he was at Leipzig. Physicists everywhere were devastated by the news that Boltzmann, in deep depression, had committed suicide. His act was difficult for many physicists to understand. His suicide seems to have been due to factors in his personal life (depressions and decline of health) rather than to any academic matters. Depressed and in bad health, he committed suicide just before experiment verified his work. In a tribute to Boltzmann, Ostwald described Boltzmann as a victim of the immense sacrifices of health and strength demanded of those who struggle for scientific truth. Some physicists ascribed Boltzmann suicide to mental instability. According to Chandrasekar, he was greatly depressed by the violent attacks made on his ideas by Ostwald and Mach. This made him to commit suicide.

zh: 就在他去世之际，又有两位著名人物加入了关于唯物主义思想之争：爱因斯坦和列宁。在探讨爱因斯坦如何于1905 年从科学上为玻尔兹曼正名、列宁如何于1908 年从哲学上为他正名之前，我们必须先梳理一下马赫对原子理论提出异议。在第五章中，我们曾回顾过从17 世纪到19 世纪初，热学领域曾存在两种相互竞争理论。机械论认为热是微小粒子运动；另一种理论则认为热是一种物质，通常被称为“热质”（caloric）。尽管如今看来难以置信，但马赫却是“热质说”晚期倡导者。
en: He died just as two more famous figures were entering the battle of ideas over materialism: Einstein and Lenin. Before we go into how Einstein vindicated Boltzmann scientifically in 1905 and Lenin vindicated him philosophically in 1908, we must run through the objections raised by Mach to the atomic theory. In Chapter 5, we recounted how, from the seventeenth to the early nineteenth centuries, there were two competing theories of heat. The mechanical theory held that heat was the motion of small particles; the alternative theory held that heat was a substance, often called
. Incredible as it now seems, Mach was a late proponent of what amounted to the
theory of heat.

zh: 人们本以为，这一切在19世纪中叶就已解决，但他在一部著作
（初版于1872年）中，给出了他认为热的机械理论缺乏依据的理由。
en: One would have imagined that all this would have been settled by the mid-nineteenth century, but in
(originally published 1872), he gave arguments as to why he considered the mechanical theory of heat unjustified. ​

zh: 如果大家还记得，反对热质说主要论据是：实验证明热量并非守恒量。热量是可以被消耗。蒸汽机和卡诺理想热机都能利用热量来做功。正如伦福德所展示那样，热量也可以通过摩擦做功产生。廷德尔、麦克斯韦、汤姆森和玻尔兹曼得出结论是：热量仅仅是机械能一种形式。马赫试图论证这一结论是不成立。
en: If you recall, the key arguments against the caloric theory had been that experiments proved that heat was not a conserved quantity. Heat could be used up. Steam engines and the ideal heat engines of Carnot were able to use up heat to do work. Heat could also be created from work by friction, as Rumford had shown. The conclusion of Tyndall, Maxwell, Thomson and Boltzmann was that heat was just a form of mechanical energy. Mach tried to argue that this was an illegitimate conclusion.

zh: 他以电现象作类比。
en: The analogy he made was with electricity.

zh: 1785年，库仑制造了他的扭秤，借此测量带电物体之间的斥力。假设有两个小球A、B，它们整体上带有相同的电荷。当两个球心相距一定距离r时，它们会相互施加某一斥力p。现在让另一小球C与B接触，使两者带上相等的电荷，然后在相同距离r处分别测量B与A、C与A之间的斥力。这两项斥力的和仍为p。因此，有某种东西保持了恒定。如果我们把这一效应归于某种物质，自然就会推断出它的恒定性。但这一说明的关键是电力p的可分性，而不是物质这一比喻。
en: In 1785 Coulomb constructed his torsion balance, by which he was enabled to measure the repulsion of electrified bodies. Suppose we have two small balls, A, B, which over their whole extent are similarly electrified. These two balls will exert on one another, at a certain distance
of their centres from one another, a certain repulsion
. We bring into contact with B, now, a ball C, suffer both to be equally electrified, and then measure the repulsion of B with A and of C from A at the same distance
. The sum of these repulsions is again

. Accordingly something has remained constant. If we ascribe this effect to a substance, then we infer naturally its constancy. But the essential point of the exposition is the divisibility of the electric force
and not the simile of substance. ​

原图字母为部件标号；Fig.为图号。
en: Figure 6.1 Coulomb balance as used in Mach’s argument. From Coulomb 1785.

zh: 1838年，里斯制造了他的电气空气温度计（热电计）。这一仪器测量莱顿瓶放电产生的热量。该热量并不正比于按库仑的方法测得的瓶中电量；若以q表示这一电量、s表示电容，则热量正比于
，或者更简单地说，正比于带电瓶的能量。现在，若让莱顿瓶通过温度计完全放电，就能得到一定的热量W。但如果让放电通过温度计进入第二个瓶子，得到的热量就少于W。不过，再使两个瓶子通过空气温度计完全放电，就能得到余下的热量；此时，热量又正比于两个瓶子的能量。因此，在第一次不完全放电时，电的做功能力就损失了一部分。
en: In 1838 Riess constructed his electrical air-thermometer (the thermoe­ lectrometer). This gives a measure of the quantity of heat produced by the discharge of jars. This quantity of heat is not proportional tc the quantity of electricity contained in the jar by Coulomb’
measure, but if
be this quantity and
be the capacity, is proportional to

, or, more simply still, to the energy of the charged jar. If, now, we discharge the jar completely through the thermometer, we obtain a certain quantity of heat, W. But if we make the discharge through the thermometer into a second jar, we obtain a quantity less than W, But we may obtain the remainder by completely discharging both jars through the air-thermometer, when it will again be proportional to the energy of the two jars. On the first, incomplete discharge, accordingly, a part of the electricity’
capacity for work was lost.

Jar 1／Jar 2：莱顿瓶1／2；charge：充电；connect：连接；Riess electro thermometer：里斯电气温度计；First experiment／Second experiment：第一次／第二次实验；Time：时间；T1—T3为温度计标记。
en: Figure 6.2 The Leiden jar experiments as described by Mach. Figure by authors.

zh: 他接着论证说，库仑
实验先进行，只是历史上的偶然。如果先做的是莱顿瓶实验，那么测量电所用的量就会是电能，而不是电荷。
en: He then argues that it was just a matter of historical accident that the Coulomb

experiment was performed first. If the Leiden jar experiment had been done first, then the way of measuring electricity would have been in terms of quantities of electrical energy, not electrical charge.

zh: 马赫提出，我们对“电”守恒（现被理解为电荷守恒）信念，源于库仑最初实验。倘若我们以能量来定义电，或许会发现电容器之间电转移——库仑球体也起着电容器作用——并不守恒。马赫把这种假想“电”损失与卡诺热机中热量非守恒现象进行了类比。
en: Mach proposed that our belief in the conservation of electricity, now understood as charge conservation, stems from Coulomb’s initial experiments. Had we defined electricity in terms of energy, we might have observed that electric transfer between capacitors, which Coulomb’s spheres also functioned as, is not conservative. Mach drew parallels between this hypothetical loss of ’electricity’ and the non-conservation of heat in Carnot’s heat engines.

zh: 他认为，把电荷看作守恒量，与把热质看作守恒量，理由同样充分。静电学承认，同样数量的电荷，随其电势不同，可以对应不同的能量。同样，一定数量的热质也可能随其势的不同而包含不同的能量。因此，温度可以看作电压在热学中的对应量：电压表示电荷的势，而温度表示物体内热质的势。
en: He argued that there is as much reason to consider electric charge conserved as there is to consider caloric conserved. Electrostatics acknowledges that a specific amount of charge can represent varying amounts of energy depending on its potential. Similarly, a certain amount of caloric might contain different energy levels based on its potential. Thus, temperature could be seen as a thermal equivalent to electrical voltage, where voltage represents the potential of a charge, and temperature represents the potential of caloric within a body.

zh: 如果科学界愿意接受电荷概念，那么就没有理由拒绝热质。
en: If science was willing to accept the notion of electric charge, then it had no reason to reject caloric.

zh: 我们该如何看待这一论点？
en: What are we to make of this argument?

zh: 对马赫静电类比的批判
再看马赫如何结束他的第一个类比，即库仑类比：“如果我们把这一效应归于某种物质，自然就会推断出它的恒定性。但这一说明的关键是电力p的可分性，而不是物质这一比喻。”注意，他在这里留了退路。他甚至没有直言自己赞同电荷具有实体性。他把电荷概念称为一种比喻，说真实存在的是电力的可分性。这符合他总体上的工具主义科学观：科学研究的是仪器测量结果之间的关系，而非发现究竟是什么东西使仪表指针运动。
en: Look again at how Mach concludes his first, Coulomb analogy: ‘If we ascribe this effect to a substance, then we infer naturally its constancy. But the essential point of the exposition is the divisibility of the electric force

and not the simile of substance’. Notice that he is hedging his bets here. He is not saying outright that he even agrees that electric charge is substantial. He calls the notion of charge a simile, saying that what is real is the divisibility of the electric force. This is in keeping with his general instrumentalist approach to science, whereby science is about relations between measurements on instruments rather than about discovering the what the things are that cause dials to move.

zh: 但如果我们考察库仑实验中一系列操作，就会发现“力的可分性”并不是对实验过程的准确描述。
en: But if we examine the sequence of actions performed in the Coulomb experiment we find that ‘divisibility of force’ is not an accurate description of what is going on.

zh: 第一步，实验者给一个小球充电（图6.1中标为d），然后将它放入扭秤。他利用扭秤顶部的刻度盘，读出该球对小球a施加的静电力。接着把小球d取出，让它与另一个小球b接触（库仑图中未画出b）。然后依次把d、b放入扭秤，分别从刻度盘上读出它们造成的偏转。
en: In the first step, an experimenter charged up
ball (shown as
in Figure 6.1 ) and inserted it into the torsion balance. He then read off the electrostatic force it exerted on the ball
using the dial at the top of the balance. Ball
was then removed from the balance and brought into contact with another ball
(which is not shown in Coulomb’s diagram). Balls
are then successively placed in the balance, and the deflections they induce read off on the dial.

zh: 把这个实验叫作对力的分割的测量，其实并不恰当，因为这里是在三个不同的时刻，分别进行了三次力的测量。真正展示力的分割，需要被分割的力同时作用，如图6.3所示。库仑观察到的是：似乎有某种东西能够在小球之间传递，使这些不同小球在不同时刻所能产生的力保持守恒。他据此推断，有某种东西——不妨称为电荷——被分配到了小球之间。
en: It is not really valid to call this a measurement of division of forces since what we have is three distinct measurements of forces at three different times. An actual division of force demonstration requires that the forces being divided act simultaneously, as in Figure 6.3. What Coulomb had observed was that there appeared to be something which could be transferred between balls in such a way that the forces that these distinct balls could induce at distinct times were conserved. He deduced that there was something, call it electric charge, which was being divided between the balls.

zh: 图6.3 真正的力的分割装置示意图。两侧重物的平衡力与中央重物的力同时作用。作者绘图。
en: Figure 6.3 Diagram of an actual division of forces setup. The balancing forces of the peripheral weights act simultaneously with the central ones. Figure by authors.

zh: 马赫声称库仑目睹了力的分割，这是一种歪曲。库仑实际注意到的是某种能够产生力的东西被分割了。马赫反对认识物自体的康德主义偏见，促使他拒绝这一观念，并错误地声称观察到的是力的分割。在力学中，力是加速度的直接动因。因此，能够积聚在髓球上或莱顿瓶内的并不是力本身，而是有潜能产生力的某种物质。
en: Mach’s assertion that Coulomb witnessed a division of force is a distortion. Coulomb actually noted a division of something that could potentially cause force. Mach’s Kantian bias against the knowledge of things in themselves prompted him to reject this notion and incorrectly assert that a division of forces was observed. In mechanics, force is an immediate agent of acceleration. Therefore, what can be accumulated on pith balls or in Leiden jars is not force per se, but rather a substance that has the potential to generate force.

zh: 如果我们现在审视马赫对莱顿瓶实验描述，会发现它同样存在谬误。绘制该实验电路图（图6.4）有助于理解。通过该图，我们可以看出他的分析中遗漏了一个关键步骤。当第一个莱顿瓶与第二个连接时，是通过一个具有一定电阻连接（图中R1）实现。马赫论述中忽略了通过该电阻器散失热量。
en: If we now look at Mach’s account of the Leiden jar experiment, we find it equally faulty. It helps to draw a circuit diagram of it (Figure 6.4). With this, we can see that a key step is left out of his analysis. When the first leiden jar is connected to the second, it is done via a connection which has some resistance (R1 in the diagram). The heat lost through this resistor is left out of Mach’s account.

en: If we did not measure h1 the heat released in shifting half the charge to capacitor C2, we would have an experiment similar to the Coulomb one, but we would note that

In Figure 6.4, the heat lost through resistor R1 is supposed to be analogous to the work out of a Carnot heat engine but this an absurd analogy on thermodynamic grounds. Mach is matching a loss of useful energy to heat through a resistor, with a conversion of heat to useful energy. But the second law of thermodynamics tells us that such transfers are not symmetric. You can transform electrical energy into heat with 100 per cent efficiency, but the conversion of heat to useful energy, whether this is electricity or mechanical work, is always less than 100 per cent efficient.

zh: 对马赫所尝试类比进行仔细考察后，会发现它根本行不通。随着我们在此详细梳理马赫论点，其荒谬之处便显而易见。他试图通过思想实验中类比来反驳原子理论，却实际上忽略了熵增定律。正是麦克斯韦和玻尔兹曼原子理论解释了熵增加。马赫却试图用类比来反驳它，完全无视了熵增加。
en: A close examination of Mach’s attempted analogy shows that it simply does not work. As we go through Mach’s argument here in detail it’s full absurdity sinks in. He was attempting to refute the atomic theory by making analogies in thought experiments in which he effectively ignored the law of increasing entropy. It is Maxwell and Boltzmann’s atomic theory that explains increasing entropy. Mach tried to refute it with analogies, just ignoring entropy increase.

zh: 或许可以为他辩解说，这本书初版于1872年，时间还相当早，恰逢玻尔兹曼发表那篇关于熵的里程碑式论文。那时尚早于麦克斯韦的《热学理论》一书，
但麦克斯韦论述中的关键内容已经发表。
即便允许马赫用几年时间消化这些思想，这个借口也很勉强。马赫在此后的岁月里并未撤回异议。1894年10月，他又在The Monist第5卷第1期上以英语发表了这篇文章，只作少量修改，再次使用同样的静电类比来反对热的机械理论。
en: In mitigation, one might say that the first publication date of the book, 1872, was quite early, the same year as Boltzmann’s landmark paper on entropy. It was before Maxwell’s book on the Theory of Heat,
but the key elements of Maxwells account had already been published.

Even supposing that Mach be allowed a few years to absorb these ideas, the excuse wears thin. Mach did not reverse his objections in subsequent years. He had the text published again in English in Vol. 5, No. I, of The Monist, October, 1894, with minor modifications repeating the same electrostatic analogies against the mechanical theory of heat.

zh: 谁能想到，就在1900年，人们还在围绕原子是否真实存在争斗，甚至可以说斗得你死我活。维也纳的大哲学家恩斯特·马赫说：不。大化学家威廉·奥斯特瓦尔德也说：不。然而在那个关键的世纪之交，一个人基于根本的理论依据，挺身捍卫原子的实在性。他就是路德维希·玻尔兹曼。……人类的进步在那一刻悬于一架精细的思想天平之上；倘若当时反原子学说真的占了上风，我们的进步肯定会倒退几十年，甚至可能倒退一百年。
en: Who could think that, only in 1900, peoples were battling, one might say to the death, over the issue whether atoms are real or not. The great philosopher Ernst Mach in Vienna said, NO. The great chemist Wilhelm Ostwald said, NO. And yet one man, at that critical turn of the century, stood up for the reality of atoms on fundamental grounds of theory. He was Ludwig Boltzmann. . . . The ascent of man teetered on a fine intellectual balance at that point, because had the anti-atomic doctrines then really won the day, our advance would certainly have been set back by decades, and perhaps a hundred years.

zh: 就在玻尔兹曼自杀前不久，一位名不见经传专利局职员发表了一系列令人惊叹四篇论文，这些论文不仅彻底证明了玻尔兹曼正确性，还把20 世纪物理学引向了一条革命性新道路。
en: Shortly before Boltzmann’s suicide, an obscure patent clerk published an astonishing sequence of four papers that both completely vindicated Boltzmann and set twentieth-century physics on a revolutionary new path.

en: On its own, this paper would have been enough to permanently refute the Machist arguments against atoms, molecules and the kinetic theory of heat. But if we look at the whole volley of papers that Einstein published over that summer, we see a developing theme of defending a corpuscular view of reality against the contenting energeticist school favoured by Mach and his supporters.

en: Einstein
lays out an argument as to why light should be viewed as corpuscular. He introduces it by saying:

zh: 光波动理论及其连续空间函数已被证明是纯粹光学现象绝佳模型，预计永远不会被其他理论所取代。尽管如此，我们应当考虑到，光学实验观测到只是时间平均值，而非瞬时值。因此，尽管麦克斯韦理论与实验结果完全吻合，但使用连续空间函数来描述光，可能会导致与实验结果矛盾，特别是在应用于光产生和转化时。
en: The wave theory of light with its continuous spatial functions has proven to be an excellent model of purely optical phenomena and presumably will never be replaced by another theory. Nevertheless, we should consider that optical experiments observe only time-averaged values, rather than instantaneous values. Hence, despite the perfect agreement of Maxwell’s theory with experiment, the use of continuous spatial functions to describe light may lead to contradictions with experiments, especially when applied to the generation and transformation of light.

zh: 特别是，黑体辐射、光致发光、紫外线产生阴极射线以及其他与光产生和转化相关现象，似乎在假设光能量在空间中呈不连续分布情况下，能得到更好建模。根据这一图景，点光源发出光波能量并非连续扩散到越来越大体积中，而是由有限数量能量量子组成，这些量子在空间中特定点上局域化，在运动过程中不会分裂，且只能作为整体被吸收或产生。
en: In particular, black body radiation, photoluminescence, generation of cathode rays from ultraviolet light and other phenomena associated with the generation and transformation of light seem better modeled by assuming that the energy of light is distributed discontinuously in space. According to this picture, the energy of a light wave emitted from a point source is not spread continuously over ever larger volumes, but consists of a finite number of energy quanta that are spatially localised at points of space, move without dividing and are absorbed or generated only as a whole.

zh: 他是如何论证这一观点？
en: How does he justify his suggestion?

zh: 起初，他考察了处于热平衡状态腔内气体，假设其本质上具有微粒性，由原子和电子组成。他提出，受各种局部静电势限制电子可以作为电磁辐射谐振器。运用分子动理论，他推导出了谐振器平均能量公式，表明该能量应与气体温度成正比。
en: Initially, he examines a gas within a cavity at thermal equilibrium, presuming it to be corpuscular in nature, composed of atoms and electrons. He posits that the electrons, confined by various local electrostatic potentials, can serve as resonators for electromagnetic radiation. Employing molecular kinetic theory, he deduces a formula for the average energy of a resonator, indicating that it should be directly proportional to the gas temperature.

Considering increasingly higher frequencies of radiation, the predicted radiant energy within a cavity would theoretically become infinite. He derives an equation for what the entropy of monochromatic light within a cavity
would be and how this entropy would change if all the energy of the light were concentrated in some sub-volume
of the cavity.
Of this, he observes:

en: This equation shows that the entropy of monochromatic radiation of sufficiently low density varies with volume according to the same law as the entropy of an ideal gas or that of a dilute solution. In the following the equation just found will be interpreted in terms of the principle introduced by Mr. Boltzmann that says that the entropy of a system is a function of the probability of its state.

zh: 这立即表明——尽管爱因斯坦并未对此多加论述——光表现出了类似原子集合体微粒性质。
en: This immediately indicates, though Einstein does not labour the point, that the light is behaving in a corpuscular way like a collection of atoms.

zh: 请思考他的成就。他两次应用了玻尔兹曼对熵统计学解释：最初是在辐射背景下，随后又在气体分子背景下。他证明了光熵随体积变化方式与气体熵相同。这使他推断出光具有粒子性，由后来被称为“光子”粒子组成。值得注意的是，他在推导腔内光熵时，并未预设光粒子性；而是从经验上得到验证黑体辐射公式中推导出了这一结论。因此，玻尔兹曼统计力学不仅在原子层面正确——爱因斯坦关于布朗运动论文便证明了这一点——而且也适用于光，从而推导出了光粒子性。
en: Reflect on his achievements. He applied Boltzmann’s statistical interpretation of entropy twice: initially in the context of radiation, and subsequently in the context of gas molecules. He demonstrated that the entropy of light changes with volume in the same manner as the entropy of gas. This led him to deduce that light is particulate, consisting of what would later be termed photons. Notably, he did not presuppose the particulate nature of light in his derivation of light’s entropy within a cavity; rather, he deduced it from the empirically validated formula for black body radiation. Thus, Boltzmann’s statistical mechanics was not only correct regarding atoms, as evidenced by Einstein’s paper on Brownian motion, but it was also applicable to light, inferring its particulate nature.

zh: 鉴于当时人们对玻尔兹曼关于气体原子理论仍持极大怀疑态度，这无疑是一个大胆推论。它意味着物理学界不仅必须摒弃对气体理论疑虑，还必须面对一个或许更为艰巨挑战——接受电磁辐射粒子理论，而此前关于电磁辐射连续波理论似乎一直是19 世纪物理学辉煌成就。
en: Given that Boltzmann’s atomic account of gases was still being treated with great scepticism, this was an audacious extension. It implied that the physics community must both drop their doubts about the gas theory and face a perhaps harder challenge – to accept a particulate theory for electromagnetic radiation, the continuous wave account of which had up until then seemed a triumph of nineteenth-century physics.

zh: 单就这一点而言，这不过是一个大胆假设，但爱因斯坦提供了实验证据来支持这一观点。光电效应早已为人所知，这是一种入射光导致真空管中冷阴极释放电子并向阳极移动现象。这种运动会产生可检测到电流。在更现代应用中，太阳能电池板正是基于这一原理工作。通过对阳极施加反向偏压，电子会被排斥，阻止电流流动。所谓“截止电压”——即电流停止流过点——表示电子从阴极发射出来时所具有能量（单位为电子伏特）。
en: This would merely be a bold hypothesis by itself, but Einstein provided experimental evidence to support it. The photoelectric effect, already known, is a phenomenon where incident light causes electrons to be emitted from a cold cathode in a vacuum tube, moving towards the anode. This movement generates a detectable current. In a more contemporary application, this principle is how solar panels operate. By applying a reverse bias to the anode, electrons are repelled, preventing current flow. The ‘stopping voltage’ – the point at which current ceases – indicates the energy, in electron volts, that the electrons possess when emitted from the cathode.

zh: 此前关于光波动理论曾预测，截止电压将由入射光强度决定。爱因斯坦理论则指出，它应由光频率决定。高频光量子具有更大能量，因此会把电子激发到更高电压。
en: The previous wave theory of light predicted that the stopping voltage would be determined by the intensity of the incident light. Einstein’s account said that it should be determined by the frequency of the light. High-frequency light quanta had more energy and would thus excite electrons to higher voltages.

zh: 实验数据支持爱因斯坦量子理论，而非波理论。截止电压取决于频率，而非强度。正是凭借在光电效应方面研究，爱因斯坦获得了诺贝尔物理学奖。
en: The experimental data aligns with Einstein’s quantum theory over the wave theory. The stopping voltage is dependent on frequency, not intensity. It was for his work on the photoelectric effect that Einstein received the Nobel Prize in Physics.

zh: 一个世纪前，光电效应还是一种鲜为人知现象，只有实验物理学家才了解。如今，它已成为我们日常生活一部分。太阳能电池板、LED 灯泡以及智能手机中摄像头都利用了这一效应。事实上，现代数码相机芯片中传感器非常灵敏，以至于击中像素离散光子数量统计波动，会在均匀背景上表现为可见“散粒噪声”。现代技术使我们能够在手机上观察到光的量子化现象。
en: A century ago, the photoelectric effect was an obscure phenomenon known only to experimental physicists. Now, it’s a part of our daily lives. Solar panels, LED light bulbs and the cameras in our smartphones all utilize it. In fact, the sensors in modern digital camera chips are so sensitive that the statistical fluctuation in the number of discrete photons striking pixels becomes visible ‘shot noise’ against a uniform background. Modern technology has made it possible to observe the quantization of light on our cell phones.

zh: 有人可能会反驳说，爱因斯坦对光电效应解释是一种事后推断。当时，光电效应实验证据早已确立。爱因斯坦理论为这些观测结果提供了解释，而连续统理论却无法做到这一点。然而，这并非一种预测。1922 年，人们发现X 射线可以被电子散射，从而导致电子获得动量，这一发现被证明是对爱因斯坦理论关键性证实。
en: It could be objected that his photo-electric was a post-diction on his part. The experimental evidence for the photoelectric effect was well-established. Einstein’s theory provided an explanation for these observed results, which the continuum theory could not. However, this was not a prediction. The 1922 discovery that X-rays could be scattered by electrons, resulting in a gain of momentum by the electrons, proved to be a crucial confirmation of Einstein’s theory.

zh: 他在1905年的最后两篇论文讨论了狭义相对论，
并推导出著名的
公式。
他推导相对论时使用的论证与唯物主义问题只有间接联系，所以这里不作讨论。
物质与能量彼此等价的结论，既具有哲学意义，也具有巨大的实践意义。在哲学上，它削弱了把“能量论”当作唯物主义替代方案的可能性。
在历史上，它开启了原子能及其所带来的一切可能。如果说有什么让原子观念深入公众心中，那就是原子能。
en: His final two 1905 papers address the theory of special relativity
and derive his famous
formula.
His arguments in deriving the theory of relativity are only tangentially relevant to the issue of materialism, so we will not go into them here.

The conclusion that matter and energy were equivalent to one another did have philosophical as well as immense practical relevance. Philosophically, it undermined the ability to appeal to ‘energetism’ as an alternative to materialism.
Historically, it opened up the possibility of atomic power with all that entails. If anything established the idea of atoms in the popular mind, it was atomic energy.

zh: 贝希托尔德
把马赫的原子观概括如下：“马赫的原子观可以归纳为五个主要观点：（a）原子不作为自在之物存在；（b）原子概念只是感觉复合体的思想符号；（c）原子论是一种没有成果的假说；（d）原子论是一种人为的假说；（e）原子论是一种没有充分依据的假说。”
en: Bächtold

summarizes Mach’s view on atoms as: ‘Mach’s view on atoms can be described as consisting of five main ideas: (a) atoms do not exist in themselves, (b) the notion of atom is only a thought-symbol for a complex of sensations, (c) atomism is an unfruitful hypothesis, (d) atomism is an artificial hypothesis and (e) atomism is an unjustified hypothesis’.

zh: 到了20 世纪中叶，马赫学派对原子观念反对似乎已显得荒谬且令人反感。广岛毁灭绝非源于某种“感觉复合体”。
en: By the mid-twentieth century, the Machist objection to the idea of atoms just seemed absurd and obscene. Hiroshima was not destroyed by a ‘complex of sensations’.

zh: 哲学马赫主义与列宁的干预
马赫影响不仅体现在阻碍了原子理论被接受。他的哲学思想塑造了半代科学家思维方式。它确立了工具主义——即科学仅仅是用于把仪器读数与感官印象相关联公式这一学说——作为许多早期量子物理学家思考量子力学所引发概念革命出发点。
en: Mach’s influence did not just extend to holding back the acceptance of the atomic theory. His philosophical teaching conditioned half of a generation of scientists. It established instrumentalism, the doctrine that science was just about formulae used to correlate instrument readings and sense impressions, as the starting point from which many of the original quantum physicists thought through the conceptual revolution induced by quantum mechanics.

zh: 与牛顿和莱布尼茨一样，
马赫强调科学思想中简洁性的优点。
en: Like Newton and Leibniz,
Mach emphasized the virtues of simplicity in scientific thought.

zh: 科学知识传播总是涉及描述，即在思想中对事实模仿性再现，其目的是取代新经验并省去相关麻烦。同样，为了节省教学和学习劳力，人们寻求简洁、概括描述。这实际上就是自然法则全部内容。只要知道重力加速度数值以及伽利略下落定律，我们便拥有了简单而简明指引，可以在思想中重现落体一切可能运动。这样公式完全可以替代一份完整下落运动表，因为借助该公式，可以随时轻松推导出该表中数据，而丝毫不给记忆带来负担。
en: The communication of scientific knowledge always involves description, that is, a mimetic reproduction of facts in thought, the object of which is to replace and save the trouble of new experience. Again, to save the labor of instruction and of acquisition, concise, abridged description is sought. This is really all that natural laws are. Knowing the value of the acceleration of gravity, and Galileo’s laws of descent, we possess simple and compendious directions for reproducing in thought all possible motions of falling bodies. A formula of this kind is a complete substitute for a full table of motions of descent, because by means of the formula the data of such a table can be easily constructed at a moment’s notice without the least burdening of the memory.

zh: 在代数中，我们尽可能把所有形式相同数值运算一次性完成，从而仅需针对个别情况进行少量工作。代数和分析中符号使用——这些符号仅仅代表待执行运算——源于这样一种观察：通过把所有机械性运算交由双手完成，我们可以实质性地减轻思维负担，从而把思维能力留给更重要、更困难任务。这种方法一个结果——也印证了其经济性——便是计算机制造。数学家巴贝奇（差分机发明者）可能是第一个清晰认识到这一事实的人，他在其著作《制造业与机械的经济性》中曾提及这一点，尽管只是略为提及。
en: In algebra we perform, as far as possible, all numerical operations which are identical in form once for all, so that only a remnant of work is left for the individual case. The use of the signs of algebra and analysis, which are merely symbols of operations to be performed, is due to the observation that we can materially disburden the mind in this way and spare its powers for more important and more difficult duties, by imposing all mechanical operations upon the hand. One result of this method, which attests its economical character, is the construction of calculating machines. The mathematician Babbage, the inventor of the difference-engine, was probably the first who clearly perceived this fact, and he touched upon it, although only cursorily, in his work, The Economy of Manufactures and Machinery.

zh: 问题在于，这一节约原则与一种实质上属于个人主义或心理主义的观念纠缠在一起：信息的节约究竟发生于何处？这里把个体感知与科学这一社会活动混为一谈。
en: The problem is that this economic principle was tied up with what amounted to an individualist or psychological conception where the information economy occured – a confusion of individual perception with the social activity of science.

zh: 当我们在思想中把一个物体从它运动于其中的可变环境中分离出来时，实际上是在我们的全部感觉之流中，抽出一组思想所关注的、比其他感觉相对更稳定的感觉。这组感觉并非绝对不变。它的成员时而出现，时而消失，或发生改变。它从不以完全相同的样态重现。然而，其恒定要素的总量与可变要素的总量相比，总是占如此大的比重，尤其是考虑到转变的连续性时更是如此，以至于就当前目的而言，前者通常似乎足以确定物体的同一性。但是，由于我们可以从这组感觉中分离出任何一个成员，而物体对我们来说仍不失为同一个，我们便容易相信：把所有成员都抽离之后，还会剩下某种额外的东西。于是，我们形成了一种有别于其属性的实体观念，即物自体观念，而把我们的感觉仅仅视为这个物自体的属性的符号或标志。然而，更妥当的说法应当是：物体或事物是感觉群的简明心理符号——这些符号并不存在于思想之外。
en: In mentally separating a body from the changeable environment in which it moves, what we really do is to extricate a group of sensations on which our thoughts are fastened and which is of relatively greater stability than the others, from the stream of all our sensations. Absolutely unalterable this group is not. Now this, now that member of it appears and disappears, or is altered. In its full identity it never recurs. Yet the sum of its constant elements as compared with the sum of its changeable ones, especially if we consider the continuous character of the transition, is always so great that for the purpose in hand the former usually appear sufficient to determine the body’s identity. But because we can separate from the group every single member without the body’s ceasing to be for us the same, we are easily led to believe that after abstracting all the members something additional would remain. It thus comes to pass that we form the notion of a substance distinct from its attributes, of a thing-in-itself, whilst our sensations are regarded merely as symbols or indications of the properties of this thing-in-itself. But it would be much better to say that bodies or things are compendious mental symbols for groups of sensations—symbols that do not exist outside of thought.

zh: 他的意思是，世界上物体并不存在，只有我们对它们思考或感觉才存在。这种唯心主义观点几乎与贝克莱学说如出一辙。我们确实对引发白垩纪—第三纪灭绝事件小行星有一种象征性表征。但杀死恐龙并非这种象征性表征，而是那块真实存在岩石与金属，正是它形成了希克苏鲁伯陨石坑。
en: He is saying that objects in the world do not exist, only our thoughts or sensations of them. This is almost Berkeleyan in its idealism. We do have a symbolic representation for the asteroid that caused the KT extinction event. But it was not this symbolic representation that killed the dinosaurs. It was a real mass of rock and metal that created the Chicxulub crater.

zh: 为什么说事物只是感觉群的心理符号、而这些符号并不存在于思想之外，会是更好的说法呢？
en: Why would it be better to say that things are just mental symbols for groups of sensation symbols that do not exist outside of thought?

zh: 他如何把这种个人主义与他在其他地方所承认科学集体性相调和？
en: How does he reconcile this individualism with what he knows about the collective nature of science which he acknowledges elsewhere?

zh: 通过交流，许多人最初各自获得经验被汇集为一。知识传播，以及每个人为了以最少思维消耗来管理自己经验储备而感受到必要性，迫使我们把知识归纳为经济形式。但这恰恰为我们提供了一条线索，它剥去了科学一切神秘面纱，并向我们展示了科学真正力量。就具体结果而言，它所提供，是我们即使不借助方法，只要时间足够长，也能达到。整个数学领域中，没有哪个问题不能通过直接计数来解决。但借助现有数学工具，许多计数运算可以在几分钟内完成，而如果没有数学方法，这些运算可能需要一辈子才能完成。正如一个完全依赖自身劳动成果人永远无法积累巨额财富，相反，许多人劳动成果积累集中于一人之手，才是财富与权力基础；同样，任何值得称之为知识东西，都无法被局限于人类寿命范围之内、且仅具备有限能力单个头脑所汇集，除非通过最精妙思维节约，以及对成千上万合作者所积累、经过经济有序整理经验进行汇集。
en: By communication, the experience of many persons, individually acquired at first, is collected in one. The communication of knowledge and the necessity which every one feels of managing his stock of experience with the least expenditure of thought, compel us to put our knowledge in economical forms. But here we have a clue which strips science of all its mystery, and shows us what its power really is. With respect to specific results it yields us nothing that we could not reach in a sufficiently long time without methods. There is no problem in all mathematics that cannot be solved by direct counting. But with the present implements of mathematics many operations of counting can be performed in a few minutes which without mathematical methods would take a lifetime. Just as a single human being, restricted wholly to the fruits of his own labor, could never amass a fortune, but on the contrary the accumulation of the labor of many men in the hands of one is the foundation of wealth and power, so, also, no knowledge worthy of the name can be gathered up in a single human mind limited to the span of a human life and gifted only with finite powers, except by the most exquisite economy of thought and by the careful amassment of the economically ordered experience of thousands of co-workers.

zh: 上述论述很好地认识到了信息的节约以及科学的集体性质。但在其他地方，我们看到的却是个人主义和心理学式的解释。马赫十分愿意承认科学通过集体努力而进步，那么过去就必定有真实的人提出了运动定律。确实存在一个真实的牛顿，马赫使用的正是他的运动定律。如果马赫能够接受其他科学家的实在性，为何又否认牛顿所解释其运动的那些行星天体的实在性？
en: The above is a good recognition of information economy along with the collective character of science. But in other places, we get individualistic and psychological accounts. Mach was quite willing to recognize that science advanced by collective effort so there must have been real people in the past who came up with the laws of motion. There was a real Newton whose laws of motion Mach used. If Mach could accept the reality of other scientists, why did he reject the reality of the planetary bodies whose motions Newton explained?

zh: 他对原子反对，正是源于这种对科学过程理解。
en: His opposition to atoms sprung directly from this conception of the scientific process.

zh: 当几何学家想理解一条曲线的形状时，会先把它分解成微小的直线元素。但他完全清楚，这些元素只是暂时而任意的手段，用于分部分地理解他无法作为整体把握的对象。一旦找到曲线的规律，他就不再考虑这些元素。同样，物理科学若把自己创造的、可变而节约的工具——分子和原子——当作现象背后的实在，忘却其年长的姊妹哲学最近获得的智慧，以机械神话取代旧的泛灵论或形而上学图式，从而制造无穷无尽的假想问题，那就有失其本分。原子必须始终像数学函数一样，作为表征现象的工具。然而，随着智力在与研究对象接触中逐渐受到训练，物理科学将放弃以石子拼成马赛克的游戏，转而探寻现象的生命之流所流经的河床的边界和形态。它所追求的目标，是对事实最简单、最节约的抽象表达。
en: When a geometer wishes to understand the form of a curve, he first resolves it into small rectilinear elements. In doing this, however, he is fully aware that these elements are only provisional and arbitrary devices for comprehending in parts what he cannot comprehend as a whole. When the law of the curve is found he no longer thinks of the elements. Similarly, it would not become physical science to see in its self-created, changeable, economical tools, molecules and atoms, realities behind phenomena, forgetful of the lately acquired sapience of her older sister, philosophy, in substituting a mechanical mythology for the old animistic or metaphysical scheme, and thus creating no end of suppositious problems. The atom must remain a tool for representing phenomena, like the functions of mathematics. Gradually, however, as the intellect, by contact with its subject-matter, grows in discipline, physical science will give up its mosaic play with stones and will seek out the boundaries and forms of the bed in which the living stream of phenomena flows. The goal which it has set itself is the simplest and most economical abstract expression of facts.

zh: 这种放弃探究现象背后真理观点，无法解释爱因斯坦如何能基于原子理论预测未被观测到现象。如果原子并不存在，爱因斯坦又如何能准确预测花粉粒扩散速率？虽然一个能经济地解释过去观测结果公式很有用，但如果没有一个能准确捕捉现实理论，预测此前未被观测到现象将是不可能。这一点既适用于爱因斯坦对布朗运动和光电效应预测，也适用于更宏大天文预测。勒维耶利用牛顿万有引力定律预测海王星位置，其依据正是需要解释其他行星轨道上摄动。该定律指明了搜索方向，而当人们在该处观测时，海王星确实被发现了。若仅把海王星视为表征这些摄动一种工具，那便是毫无意义。同样，广义相对论并非对既定事实简单表述；它是一套描述真实宇宙几何性质理论。该理论预言了1915 年尚不为人知、且直到很久以后才被观测到众多现象。爱因斯坦理论预测了1919 年日食期间埃丁顿观测结果：恒星视位置会因太阳引力而发生偏移。近年来，该理论预测引力波和黑洞也已得到观测证实。
en: This viewpoint, which abandons efforts to comprehend the truths behind phenomena, fails to explain how Einstein could predict unobserved phenomena based on atomic theory. If atoms are non-existent, how could Einstein accurately forecast the diffusion rate of pollen grains? While a formula that economically accounts for past observations is useful, without a theory that accurately captures reality, predicting previously unobserved phenomena would be unfeasible. This applies as much to Einsteins Brownian motion and photoelectric predictions as it does to grander astronomical ones. Le Verrier’s prediction of Neptune’s location, using Newton’s law of gravity, was based on the need to explain the perturbations in other planets’ orbits. This law indicated where to search, and upon looking there, Neptune was indeed observed. To consider Neptune merely as a tool to represent these perturbations would be non-sensical. Similarly, general relativity was not just a simple representation of pre-existing facts; it was a theory describing the real universe’s geometric properties. It forecasted numerous phenomena that were unknown in 1915 and only observed much later. Einstein’s theory predicted Edingtons’s observations during the 1919 solar eclipse that the apparent positions of stars would be shifted by the Sun’s gravity. In more recent years, the gravitational waves and black holes predicted by the theory have been observed.

zh: 在机器学习领域，人们普遍认为，一个在训练集上拟合良好模型在新数据上可能表现不佳。这一现象已广为认可，因此在研究中，使用与训练集不同数据集来评估模型已成为标准做法。只有在未见过示例上表现良好模型才会被视为值得信赖。同样，关于熵的原子理论、关于光的光子理论以及广义相对论都被视为稳健模型。它们优势不仅在于拟合现有数据，更在于把握了客观的因果机制。
en: In machine learning, it’s a common understanding that a model well-fitted to the training set might perform poorly on new data. This phenomenon is so recognized that evaluating a model on a separate dataset from the training set is a standard practice in research. Only models that perform well on previously unseen examples are deemed trustworthy. Similarly, the atomic theory of entropy, the photon theory of light and general relativity are considered robust models. Their strength lies not just in fitting existing data but in encapsulating objective causal mechanisms.

zh: 就在爱因斯坦论文发表之后，但在这些论文尚未产生太大影响之前，一位笔名为列宁俄罗斯社会主义者出版了一本书，对马赫主义进行了批判。
事实证明，这位社会主义者后来成为了苏联首任总理，
因此，他对马赫批判被反复转载，并对苏联哲学产生了重大影响。
en: Just after Einstein’s papers came out, but before they had yet made much impact, a Russian socialist with the pen-name Lenin, published a book attaching Machism.
As it transpired, this socialist later went on to become the first Soviet Premier,
and as a result, his criticism of Mach was repeatedly reprinted and had a big influence on Soviet philosophy.
body.review: 底本attaching Machism按上下文应为attacking；英文照录，中文按批判译。

zh: 作为政治家和政治理论家，列宁对马赫批判与爱因斯坦相比，技术性要弱得多。爱因斯坦通过质疑马赫关于原子物理主张来间接反驳他，而列宁则直接挑战了马赫理论哲学基础。
en: As a politician and political theorist, Lenin’s critiques of Mach were significantly less technical compared to Einstein’s. While Einstein indirectly contested Mach by disputing his physical claims about atoms, Lenin directly confronted the philosophical bases of Mach’s theories.

zh: 马赫对原子存在深刻怀疑——这似乎与19 世纪科学进步相矛盾——是更广泛反唯物主义立场一部分。源于古希腊唯物主义原子论，传统上一直与这种观点相对立。马赫不仅否认原子存在，更否认所有物质对象存在：“更恰当说法是，即物体或事物是感觉群的简明心理符号——这些符号在思想之外并不存在。”
en: Mach’s profound scepticism regarding the existence of atoms, which appears contradictory to the progress of nineteenth-century science, was an element of a broader anti-materialist stance. Atomism, originating from ancient Greek materialism, traditionally countered this perspective. Mach did not just deny the existence of atoms but of all material objects: ‘it would be much better to say that bodies or things are compendious mental symbols for groups of sensations – symbols that do not exist outside of thought’.

zh: 他断言，感觉才是根本，而物质实体仅仅是感觉群的心理或概念符号。因此，如果一个人始终对物质世界持怀疑态度，那么从逻辑上讲，这种怀疑自然会延伸到对物质最小单元——原子——存在产生怀疑。
en: He asserts that sensations are fundamental, and material bodies merely represent mental or conceptual symbols for clusters of sensations. Consequently, if one consistently doubts the material world, it logically extends to doubting the existence of matter’s minutest elements – atoms.

zh: 马赫把物理科学视为心理学一个分支，把心理现象和个人经验置于现实核心。对他而言，其他一切都是幻象，尽管是一个连贯幻象。列宁曾就这段话评论道：
en: Mach considered physical science a branch of psychology, placing psychological phenomena and personal experience at the core of reality. To him, everything else was an illusion, albeit a coherent one. Lenin remarked on this passage:

zh: 老调重弹了，最可敬的教授！这完全是在重复贝克莱的话：物质是一个赤裸的抽象符号。但实际上，赤裸的正是恩斯特·马赫，因为，如果他不承认“可感内容”是独立于我们而存在的客观实在，那么剩下的就只有一个“赤裸的抽象的”我，一个必定要大写并用斜体标出的我，等同于“那架发疯的钢琴，它以为自己是世上唯一存在的东西”
。如果我们的感觉的“可感内容”不是外部世界，那么就只剩下这个沉湎于空洞“哲学”幻想的赤裸的我。这是一种愚蠢而徒劳的消遣！
en: An old song, most worthy Professor! This is a literal repetition of Berkeley who said that matter is a naked abstract symbol. But it is Ernst Mach, in fact, who goes naked, for if he does not admit that the ‘sensible content’ is an objective reality, existing independently of us, there re- mains only a ‘naked abstract’ I, an I infallibly written with a capital letter and italicised, equal to ‘the insane piano, which imagined that it was the sole existing thing in this world’
. If the ‘sensible content’ of our sensations is not the external world, then nothing exists save this naked I engaged in empty ‘philosophical’ fancies. A stupid and fruitless occupation!

zh: 马赫把“事物”仅仅是感觉符号这一比喻一直推演到原子层面，并以钠为例加以说明。
en: Mach pursued the metaphor that ‘things’ were just symbols for sensations all the way down to atoms, giving as an example sodium.

zh: 物理学家看到一个物体被弯曲、拉伸、熔化并汽化，便把它切割成更小永久性部分；化学家则把它分解为元素。然而，即便是元素也并非一成不变。以钠为例。当受热时，这种白色、银色块状物会变成液体；若继续加热并隔绝空气，它便转化为紫色蒸汽；若再进一步加热，则会发出黄光。之所以仍保留“钠”这一名称，既是因为这些转变具有连续性，也是出于一种必要的节约本能。通过冷凝蒸汽，可以使白色金属重新显现。事实上，即使金属投入水中并转化为氢氧化钠，那些消失性质通过巧妙处理仍可重新显现；正如一个运动物体经过柱子后方、暂时消失在视线中，过一会儿又会重新出现。毫无疑问，只要某一组性质有可能出现，随时准备好相应名称和概念是非常方便。但这个名称和概念，不过是这些现象一个简明而节约的符号罢了。对于那些无法借此唤起一大群井然有序感官印象人来说，它不过是一个空洞词语。对于化学元素被进一步分解成分子和原子，情况也是如此。
en: The physicist who sees a body flexed, stretched, melted, and vaporised, cuts up this body into smaller permanent parts; the chemist splits it up into elements. Yet even an element is not unalterable. Take sodium. When warmed, the white, silvery mass becomes a liquid, which, when the heat is increased and the air shut out, is transformed into a violet vapor, and on the heat being still more increased glows with a yellow light. If the name sodium is still retained, it is because of the continuous character of the transitions and from a necessary instinct of economy. By condensing the vapor, the white metal may be made to reappear. Indeed, even after the metal is thrown into water and has passed into sodium hydroxide, the vanished properties may by skilful treatment still be made to appear; just as a moving body which has passed behind a column and is lost to view for a moment may make its appearance after a time. It is unquestionably very convenient always to have ready the name and thought for a group of properties wherever that group by any possibility can appear. But more than a compendious economical symbol for these phenomena, that name and thought is not. It would be a mere empty word for one in whom it did not awaken a large group of well-ordered sense-impressions. And the same is true of the molecules and atoms into which the chemical element is still further analysed.

zh: 因此，在马赫看来，钠原子只是一组感觉印象的符号。归根结底，既不存在钠原子，也不存在任何原子；它们只是我们用来赋予感觉印象以一致性的观念。
en: So, for Mach the sodium atom was just a symbol for a set of sense impressions. Ultimately, there were no sodium atoms, no atoms in general; these were just ideas we used to impose consistency on our impressions.

zh: 对列宁而言，唯物主义核心在于它主张物质世界独立于我们感知。这一假设是所有务实的人所共有，只有唯心主义哲学家对此提出质疑。列宁指出，马赫颠覆了这一观点，把人类经验置于一切之上。尽管马赫拥有物理学背景并为科学哲学做出了贡献，但列宁认为，他哲学不过是贝克莱主教思想的回声。

作为一名社会主义政治家，列宁深刻认识到哲学与政治之间密切联系。贝克莱曾明确表示，他唯心主义旨在对抗当时无神论者。《百科全书》编纂者、法国大革命的哲学家狄德罗曾严厉批评贝克莱，视其为教会和王权捍卫者。在列宁所处时代，中欧和东欧君主制正面临革命运动威胁，这些运动最终在1917 年至1918 年间推翻了这些政权。在列宁看来，马赫对贝克莱思想复兴，是又一次旨在强化教会和王权、以对抗无神论社会主义运动哲学干预。值得注意的是，马赫作为维也纳大学哲学教授职位，必须得到奥匈帝国皇帝弗朗茨·约瑟夫亲自批准。
en: For Lenin, the crux of materialism lay in its claim that the material world is independent of our perception. This assumption is one shared by all pragmatic individuals, with only idealist philosophers questioning it. Lenin argued that Mach subverted this idea, elevating human experience above all else. Despite Mach’s background in physics and his contributions to the philosophy of science, Lenin contended that his philosophy merely echoed that of Bishop Berkeley.

As a socialist politician, Lenin was keenly aware of the deep connection between philosophy and politics. Berkeley had made it clear that his idealism aimed to counter the atheists of his time. Diderot, the Encyclopedist and philosopher of the French Revolution, had sharply criticized Berkeley, viewing him as a defender of the Church and Crown. In Lenin’s era, the monarchies of Central and Eastern Europe were under threat from revolutionary movements that would, between 1917 and 1918, ultimately topple them. To Lenin, the revival of Berkeleyian ideas by Mach was another philosophical intervention into politics designed to reinforce Church and Crown against the atheistic socialist movement. It is perhaps worth noting that Mach’s position, professor of philosophy in Vienna, was one that had to be personally approved by the Austro-Hungarian Emperor Franz Joseph.

zh: 列宁指出，马赫唯心主义并不彻底。他援引马赫话说，随着科学发展，原则上应该可以通过检查大脑，来判断其正在经历什么样体验。这如今确实已经可以实现，Shen 等人
表明，通过结合功能性磁共振成像和对抗性神经网络，端到端模型可以学习大脑活动与感知之间直接映射关系。当受试者注视一幅图片时，神经网络以功能性磁共振成像数据为输入，便能在屏幕上生成对该人所见景象尚可再现。具体示例见图6.5。但列宁质疑：这如何能与马赫把感觉视为第一性相一致？因为这实际上承认了感觉是组织化物质——即大脑——结果。
en: Mach, Lenin said, was only halfhearted in his idealism. He cites Mach as saying that with the advance of science, it should in principle be possible, by examining a brain, to say what experiences it was undergoing. This is indeed now possible, Shen et al.

show that using a combination of functional magnetic resonance and adversarial neural nets the end-to-end model can learn a direct mapping between brain activity and perception. When a subject is looking at a picture, the neural net, using as inputs fMR data, can generate on a screen a passable representation of what the person is seeing. For examples see Figure 6.5. But Lenin asks how this can be consistent with Mach making sensations primary, since it is effectively an admission that sensations are a result of organized matter – the brain.

zh: 图6.5 利用脑扫描，可以重建一个人正在看到的景象。A行：呈现给受试者的图像；B行：利用关于其脑活动的实时信息，由计算机重建的感知内容。取自Shen等人的研究。
A：呈现图像；B：重建图像。
en: Figure 6.5 It is possible, using brain scanning to reconstruct what a person is seeing. Row A: images presented to a subject; row B: computer reconstruction of what they are perceiving using real-time information about the activity of their brain. From the work of Shen et al.

zh: 这意味着，在我们之外，独立于我们和我们的意识，存在着物质的运动，例如具有一定波长和速度的以太波；它们作用于视网膜，使人产生某种颜色的感觉。自然科学正是这样看待这个问题的。它用存在于人类视网膜之外、人体之外并独立于人的不同波长的光波，解释各种颜色的感觉。这就是唯物主义：物质作用于我们的感觉器官，产生感觉。感觉依赖于大脑、神经、视网膜等，即依赖于以一定方式组织起来的物质。物质的存在并不依赖于感觉。
en: This means that outside us, independently of us and of our minds, there exists a movement of matter, let us say of ether waves of a definite length and of a definite velocity, which, acting upon the retina, produce in man the sensation of a particular colour. This is precisely how natural science regards it. It explains the sensations of various colours by the various lengths of light-waves existing outside the human retina, outside man and independently of him. This is materialism: matter acting upon our sense-organs produces sensation. Sensation depends on the brain, nerves, retina etc, ie on matter organised in a definite way. The existence of matter does not depend on sensation.

zh: 量子理论中的唯心主义与唯物主义

children: Idealism and materialism in the quantum theory

zh: 列宁写作时，物质的原子理论正处于革命性变革之中。同时，爱因斯坦提出光由量子化的光子组成，给经典物理学带来了矛盾：这似乎与有大量经验证据支持、已经确立的光的波动理论相冲突。随后，卢瑟福
通过薄金箔对β辐射的散射表明，此前被认为是实心的原子，实际上大部分是空隙，只有一个很小的原子核。同年，尼科尔森
提出，原子的大部分体积由电子轨道占据，而电子允许的角动量是普朗克常数h的倍数。
en: Lenin was writing during a revolutionary period in the atomic theory of matter. Meanwhile, Einstein had introduced a contradiction to classical physics by proposing that light consists of quantized photons, seemingly at odds with the well-established wave theory of light, which was supported by considerable empirical evidence. Then Rutherford

showed, by the scattering of beta radiation from thin gold foil that atoms, which had previously been thought of as solid, were in fact mostly void with only a tiny nucleus. In the same year Nicholson,
proposed that the bulk of the volume of atoms was occupied by electron orbits, with the allowable angular momenta of the electrons being multiples of Plank’s constant
body.review: 底本确实写beta radiation，照译β辐射；未静默改成α粒子。

zh: 因此，如果如索末菲所提出的那样，常数h在原子层面具有意义，那么当电子离开或返回时，原子的角动量或许只能以离散的量增加或减少。不难看出，这种观点比通常的解释更容易理解；后者被认为意味着能量本身具有原子式的构成。
en: If, therefore, the constant

has, as Sommerfeld has suggested, an atomic significance, it may mean that the angular momentum of an atom can only rise or fall by discrete amounts when electrons leave or return. It is readily seen that this view presents less difficulty to the mind than the more usual interpretation, which is believed to involve an atomic constitution of energy itsef.

zh: 到第二年，玻尔
已把这一观点整合进原子理论中，该理论能够解释所观测到元素发射光谱。在他模型中，原子类似于一个微型太阳系，电子围绕带正电原子核运行。这是一种对原子结构半量子化处理。虽然轨道是按经典理论分析，但它们受普朗克常数限制，该常数把电子可能角动量进行了量子化。然而，玻尔对爱因斯坦关于光具有粒子性观点并不满意，认为这与已知光干涉能力相矛盾。他与其他人一起，试图构建一种辐射理论
，把他原子模型与经典电磁学相结合，从而消除对光子需求。尽管他1924 年提出理论细节很快就被实验数据所推翻，但他在这篇论文中哲学论述，间接地为后来马赫学派物理学哲学观点复兴铺平了道路。
en: By the following year, Bohr

had integrated this into a theory of the atom, which could explain the observed emission spectra of the elements. In his model, the atom resembled a miniature solar system with electrons orbiting a positively charged nucleus. It was a semi-quantum approach to atomic structure. While orbits were analysed classically, they were restricted by Planck’s constant, which quantized the possible angular momenta for the electrons. Bohr, however, was dissatisfied with Einstein’s idea that light was particulate, finding it contradictory to the known interference capabilities of light. Along with others, he attempted to construct a theory

of radiation that would integrate his model of the atom with classical electrodynamics, obviating the need for the photon. While the details of his 1924 theory were soon contradicted by experimental data, his philosophical remarks in the paper opened up what later, and indirectly, became a recurrence of essentially Machian philosophical views of physics.

zh: 尽管对应原理使得通过估算跃迁概率来推断原子在给定定态中停留平均时间成为可能，但在确定与跃迁相关辐射发射发生时间间隔这一问题上，却存在巨大困难。事实上，这一难题连同量子理论中其他著名悖论，加剧了各方表达疑虑：即关于物质与辐射之间相互作用详细解释，是否能够完全基于迄今用于解释自然现象那种时空因果描述来给出。
en: Although the correspondence principle makes it possible through the estimation of probabilities of transition to draw conclusions about the mean time which an atom remains in a given stationary state, great difficulties have been involved in the problem of the time-interval in which emission of radiation connected with the transition lakes place. In fact, together with other well-known paradoxes of the quantum theory, the latter difficulty has strengthened the doubt, expressed from various sides whether the detailed interpretation of the interaction between matter and radiation can be given at all in terms of a causal description in space and time of the kind hitherto used for the interpretation of natural phenomena

zh: 玻尔因果描述暗示了能量和动量守恒。在他1924 年论文中，他试图通过提出能量和动量守恒在统计平均意义上成立，来弥合经典力学与量子力学之间鸿沟。他推测，虽然动量在许多电子能级跃迁中会守恒，但在每个单独电子与假设虚拟电磁场相互作用中，动量可能并不守恒。然而，这一观点很快就被推翻了——电子散射光子实验证实，在每次相互作用中动量都是守恒，这导致爱因斯坦光子假说被广泛接受。
en: Bohr’s causal description implied that energy and momentum conservation were maintained. In his 1924 paper, he tried to bridge the gap between classical and quantum mechanics by proposing that energy and momentum conservation applied on average, statistically. He theorized that while momentum would be conserved across many electron energy transitions, it might not be in each separate electron interaction with a hypothesized virtual electromagnetic field. However, he was quickly disproven as experiments with photon scattering by electrons confirmed that momentum was conserved in each interaction, leading to the widespread acceptance of Einstein’s photon hypothesis.

zh: 不过，关于量子系统中因果关系哲学问题仍由玻尔不断提出。
en: However, the philosophical points about causality in quantum systems continued to be raised by Bohr.

zh: 尽管由此给量子理论构建带来了困难，但正如我们将看到，其本质似乎可以表述为所谓“量子公设”——该公设赋予任何原子过程一种本质上不连续性，或者更确切地说，一种与经典理论完全相悖“个体性”，并以普朗克“作用量子”为象征。
en: Notwithstanding the difficulties which hence are involved in the formulation of the quantum theory, it seems, as we shall see, that its essence may be expressed in the so-called quantum postulate, which attributes to any atomic process an essential discontinuity, or rather individuality, completely foreign to the classical theories and symbolised by Planck’s quantum of action.

zh: 这一公设意味着放弃对原子过程作因果性的时空协调描述。事实上，我们通常对物理现象的描述，完全建立在这样一种观念上：可以观察相关现象而不对其造成可察觉的扰动。
en: This postulate implies a renunciation as regards the causal space-time co-ordination of atomic processes. Indeed, our usual description of physical phenomena is based entirely on the idea that the phenomena concerned may be observed without disturbing them appreciably.

zh: 而量子公设意味着，任何对原子现象的观察，都涉及与观测装置之间不可忽略的相互作用。因此，既不能赋予现象、也不能赋予观测装置以通常物理意义上的独立实在性。毕竟，观测概念在某种意义上是任意的，因为它取决于哪些对象被纳入待观测的系统。当然，最终每一次观测都可以归结为我们的感觉知觉。
en: Now the quantum postulate implies that any observation of atomic phenomena will involve an interaction with the agency of observation not to be neglected. Accordingly, an independent reality in the ordinary physical sense can neither be ascribed to the phenomena nor to the agencies of observation. After all, the concept of observation is in so far arbitrary as it depends upon which objects are included in the system to be observed. Ultimately every observation can of course be reduced to our sense perceptions.

zh: 虽然最后一句颇有马赫主义认识论意味，但玻尔通过此前提及“观测装置”这一表述，在某种程度上为其论断规避了主观主义指责。例如，光子观测装置可以是一块照相底片。鉴于后来被称为“波函数坍缩”现象，碘化银晶体与视紫红质分子在视网膜中作用同样有效。他接着说道：
en: While the last sentence is redolent of the Machist theory of knowledge, Bohr hedged his statement against subjectivism somewhat with the previous reference to ‘agencies of observation’. An agency of observation of photons could, for instance, be a photographic plate. In the light of what would latter be called the collapse of the wave function, a crystal of silver iodide would be as effective as a molecule of visual purple in the retina. He goes on:

zh: 就光而言，其在时空中传播可由电磁理论充分阐明。特别是真空中发生干涉现象以及物质介质光学性质，完全受波理论叠加原理支配。然而，在辐射与物质相互作用过程中能量和动量守恒——如光电效应和康普顿效应所示——恰恰通过爱因斯坦提出光量子概念得到了恰当阐释。
en: As regards light, its propagation in space and time is adequately expressed by the electromagnetic theory. Especially the interference phenomena in vacuo and the optical properties of material media are completely governed by the wave theory superposition principle. Nevertheless, the conservation of energy and momentum during the interaction between radiation and matter, as evident in the photoelectric and Compton effect, finds its adequate expression just in the light quantum idea put forward by Einstein.

zh: 众所周知，这一表面矛盾一方面引起对叠加原理有效性的怀疑，另一方面引起对守恒定律有效性的怀疑；这些怀疑已被直接实验明确排除。这种情况似乎清楚地表明，不可能对光现象作因果性的时空描述。一方面，当我们试图根据量子公设追踪光的时空传播规律时，只能进行统计考量；另一方面，要使以作用量子为特征的单个光过程满足因果性要求，就必须放弃时空描述。
en: As is well known, the doubts regarding the validity of the superposition principle on one hand and of the conservation laws on the other, which were suggested by this apparent contradiction, have been definitely disproved through direct experiments. This situation would seem clearly to indicate the impossibility of a causal space-time description of the light phenomena. On one hand, in attempting to trace the laws of the time-spatial propagation of light according to the quantum postulate, we are confined to statistical considerations. On the other hand, the fulfilment of the claim of causality for the individual light processes, characterised by the quantum of action, entails a renunciation as regards the space-time description.

zh: 玻尔因其表述晦涩而受到批评，因此让我们更仔细地看看他似乎想要表达什么。
这些措辞中蕴含着许多隐含含义。
en: Bohr was criticized for the obscurity of his statements, so let’s look a bit more closely at what he seems to have meant.
There are a lot of implied meanings in the language.

zh: 首先，他所说的叠加原理指什么？在当代关于量子计算等问题的讨论中，人们谈的是基矢态的叠加；但在20世纪20年代中期，物理学用这个术语指产生干涉的波的叠加。因此，他所说的叠加原理就是光学干涉。他提到的疑虑，即如何把干涉现象与爱因斯坦处理光子时涉及的守恒定律结合起来，正是他本人在玻尔、克拉默斯和斯莱特合著论文中表达的疑虑。
en: First, what does he mean by the superposition principle? In contemporary discussions about, for example, quantum computing, one speaks of superposition of base states, but in the mid-1920s, the term was used in physics to refer to the superposition of waves producing interference, so by the superposition principle, he means optical interference. The doubts to which he refers, about combining interference phenomena with the conservation laws involved in Einstein’s treatment of the photon, are therefore his own doubts expressed in Bohr, Kramers and Slater.

zh: 当他谈到试图追踪光的时空传播时，指的是求解麦克斯韦方程组，从而得到光波的振幅。但这个解只给出到达某处——例如照相底片上某一点——的光的振幅。电磁场振幅的平方给出到达该点的光子通量，但单个光子随机到达，服从泊松统计。因此，他说“我们只能进行统计考量”。
en: When he talks about attempting to trace the time-space propagation of light, he is talking about the solution to Maxwell’s equations, which give the amplitude of the light wave. But this solution only gives an amplitude for the light arriving at, for example, a given point on a photographic plate. The square of this electromagnetic field amplitude gives the flux of photons arriving at that point, but the individual photons arrive randomly with Poisson statistics. Thus, his statement that ‘we are confined to statistical considerations’

zh: 当他接着将这一点与“满足因果性要求”相对照时，指的仍是守恒定律，正如他1924年的论文中所说。经典物理学的整个因果结构都围绕能量和动量守恒建立。行星及其卫星遵循的时空路径，是使能量和动量守恒的路径。但他说，在量子力学中，如果要讨论能量守恒，就必须从麦克斯韦的光模型转向爱因斯坦的模型：我们所能说的，只是一个原子在时刻
发射一个光子，另一个原子在时刻
吸收这个光子。在这两个事件之间，无法为光子指定一条确定的路径。
en: When he then contrasts this with ‘the fulfilment of the claim of causality’, he is referring, as he did in his 1924 paper, to the conservation laws. The whole causal structure of classical physics was structured around the conservation of energy and momentum. The space-time paths followed by the planets and their satellites were those which conserved energy and momentum. But in quantum mechanics, he said that if we want to talk about energy conservation, we are forced to move from Maxwell’s model of light to Einstein’s and all you have is an emission of a photon from one atom at time t0 and an absorption of the photon by another atom at time t1. In between those to events we can assign no definite path to the photon.

为了产生这种效应，每个光子必须同时穿过多条光栅条纹，因此它们在发射与吸收之间位置是未定义。
en: If you set up a spectrometer using a diffraction grating, expose it to a very low flux of monochromatic light such that on average only one photon at a time is passing through the grating, you still get a clear spectral line on long exposure.
The photons must each have passed through multiple grating lines at once to produce this effect, so their positions between emission and absorption are undefined.

en: Bohr and Heisenberg were later to be associated with what became known as the Copenhagen interpretation of quantum theory, though it is arguable that they differed substantially in their views and the popular account of the Copenhagen theory is somewhat of a myth.
As we have said, for Bohr a
interpretation meant one in terms of the conservation laws. For Heisenberg a

interpretation was in terms of the deterministic operation of wave functions. The wave function evolved in a deterministic fashion with respect to time. The function assigns amplitudes to the orthogonal bases of some state space such that the square of these amplitudes gives the probability of observing the system in the corresponding basis state. This is formally the same as the optical case, where the square of the field amplitude gives the photon flux. For Heisenberg, the actual detection of a particle, or more generally, the detection of a basis state of the system, constituted a cut or
between the quantum world governed by the evolution of the wave function and the classical world in which the result was observed.

zh: 这套计算无疑是正确。玻尔互补观点最初是通过波包模型中波包在傅里叶意义上位置不确定性来阐述，而在分束器等实验装置中，这一特性表现得尤为明显。在实验装置中两个探测器之一触发之前，光子可能位于任一通道中。由于两束光分支可以任意延长，光子空间位置也变得任意不确定。
en: The maths certainly works. Bohr’s complementary view, initially expressed in terms of how the wave packet view involved an ambiguous position to the packet in Fourier terms, becomes much more pronounced with a setup like a beam splitter. Until one of the two detectors in the setup fires, the photon could be in either channel. Since the arms of the two beams can be arbitrarily extended, the spatial position of the photon also becomes arbitrarily indeterminate.

zh: 玻尔互补方法实质上指出：数学推导是明确且经验上正确，但在光子被探测之前，无法对其位置进行有意义描述。我们只能基于把光视为波假设进行计算，以预测最终位置相对概率。光子抽象概念本质上与特定位置能量量子发射或吸收过程紧密相连。它使我们能够把发生事情理解为一种能量守恒过程，但禁止我们同时讨论连接这两个事件时空过程。这些必须通过光波来处理，光波告诉我们不同位置预期亮度之间关系。
en: Bohr’s complementary approach effectively says that the maths is well defined and empirically correct, but that you cannot meaningfully speak of the position of the photon before it is detected. You just have to use the calculations based on treating light as a wave to predict the relative probabilities of final positions. The photon abstraction is inherently tied to the process of emission or absorption of quanta of energy at particular places. It allows us to understand what happens as something that conserves energy, but it prohibits us from simultaneously talking about the space-time process that connects the two events. These have to be dealt with in terms of light waves, which tell us the relationship between expected brightness in different places.

zh: 海森堡方法则略有不同。波（或波函数）随时间沿所有可能路径演化，随后，当进行测量且其中一个探测器触发时，量子世界与经典世界之间便发生了一次“切割”。这有时被称为波函数坍缩。
en: Heisenberg’s approach was subtly different. The wave ( or wave function ), evolves through time along all possible paths and then, when a measurement is performed and one of the detectors fires, then there is a ‘cut’ between the quantum world and the classical world. This is sometimes spoken of as there being a collapse of the wave.

zh: 玻尔的这一表述并没有内在的唯心主义性质。如果一个人是严格的唯物主义者，承认存在的一切就是原子以及原子借以交换力和能量的光子，
那么谈论光子在两次影响原子之间的位置，就成了没有意义的唯心主义。我们可能愿意想象光子在发射与吸收之间具有一个位置，但那只是想象，只是在头脑中构造一幅观念图景。既然光子和原子是实在的基本组成部分，那么，独立于原子相互作用的、观念中的光子位置，按定义就是不真实的。
en: There is nothing inherently idealistic about the Bohr statement of things. If one is a strict materialist and accepts that all that exists are the atoms and the photons

by which they exchange force and energy, then speaking of where the photons are between when they influence atoms is meaningless idealism. We may like to imagine the photon as having a position in between emission and absorption, but that is just imagination. It is just an attempt to form an ideal picture in our minds. Since the photons and the atoms are the fundamental components of reality, an ideal position of a photon independent of atomic interaction is by definition unreal.

zh: 但海森堡的解释确实可能引向唯心主义的解释，如今常称为哥本哈根诠释。
按照这种解释，正是认识主体即观察者的参与，使波函数坍缩并出现一个确定的结果。海森堡
声称：“当‘客观实在’这样的概念用于原子物理学中的情形时，它们并没有不言自明的含义。”赋予观察者的心理体验以特权地位，这看起来很像回到马赫式实证主义；在他受训练的年代，这种思潮曾深刻影响德国物理学。
en: Heisenberg’s account does lead to potentially idealist accounts though, now often known as the Copenhagen interpretation,
in which it is the participation of the knowing subject, the observer, that causes the wave function to collapse and a definite result to be seen. Heisenberg

claims: ‘such concepts as “objective reality” have no immediately evident meaning, when they are applied to the situation which one finds in atomic physics’. This process of giving a privileged position to the psychological experience of the observer looks very like a reversion to the Machist positivism that had been so influential in German physics back when he had been trained.

zh: 如果我们把视角从20 世纪30 年代物理实验室转向现代通信技术，观察者特殊角色便完全失去了可信度。当廖等人
架设激光器和望远镜，向无人卫星“墨子号”发送偏振光子时，观察者又在哪里呢？
en: If we move from the perspective of the 1930s physics lab to that of modern communications technology, the special role of the observer loses all credibility. When Liao et al.
set up their lasers and telescopes to send polarized photons to the unmanned satellite
, where was the observer?

zh: “墨子”号上自动设备记录了偏振光子，机载处理器利用这些光子把加密密钥存储在随机存取存储器（RAM）中，随后用该密钥向地面发送无线电信息。那里肯定没有人。如果波包发生了坍缩，那么那是那里设备在无人协助情况下完成。难道我们要说计算机是主体吗？
en: The automatic equipment in

recorded the polarized photons and the on-board processor used them to store in RAM the encryption key that it used to send subsequent radio messages to the ground. There was certainly no person up there. If wave packets collapsed, then the equipment up there did it unaided. Are we to say computers are subjects?

zh: 抑或我们只应承认，哲学意义上的主体
与理解这类工程技术无关？
en: Or should we just recognize that the philosophical subject
is irrelevant to understanding this sort of engineering?

zh: 海森堡学派潜藏的主观主义引起了反对，最初的反对见相关研究，
后来则有玻姆
和埃弗雷特
提出的其他实在论解释。
en: The latent subjectivism of the Heisenberg school gave rise to opposition, initially from
and later from the alternative realist interpretations of Bohm
and Everett.

zh: 这两种替代性实在论方法，分别优先考虑玻姆粒子诠释和埃弗雷特波诠释。
en: The two alternative realist approaches prioritize either the particle interpretation for Bohm or the wave interpretation for Everett.

zh: 玻姆认为，微观层面上看似存在非决定论与宏观层面上存在统计可预测性，不应阻止我们寻找更深层次决定论机制。
en: Bohm argued that the existence of apparent indeterminism at a microscopic level and statistical predictability at a macro level should not prevent us from looking for deeper deterministic mechanisms.

zh: 在给定统计规律的范围内，个体行为的无规律性，一般而言，与更广泛范围内起作用的更详细的个体规律并不矛盾。
en: lawlessness of individual behaviour in the context of a given statistical law is, in general, consistent with more detailed individual laws operating in a broader context.

zh: 他举例说明了一家寿险公司运作：该公司能够预测一名男子在特定年份死亡可能性。他们无法确切预测该男子是否会死亡，但可以针对其承保数百万客户群体做出准确预测。某人死亡仅在统计上可预测这一事实，并不意味着该个体死亡没有明确物质原因。也许是由于飞行控制机制故障导致客机空难，也许是肺癌。如果我们仅满足于统计死亡率，我们就不会去研究癌症成因、737MAX 飞行计算机可靠性等问题。玻姆借鉴了德布罗意早期研究
，后者最先证明物质粒子与光一样，也具有波特性。
en: He gave as an example the operation of a life insurance company that can predict the likelihood of a man dying in a particular year. They cannot predict with certainty if he will die, but they can make an accurate prediction over the ensemble of millions of customers they assure. The fact that the death of one man was only statistically predictable does not mean that there was not a definite material cause of this individual death. Perhaps it was an airliner crash due to a faulty flight control meachanism or perhaps lung cancer. Were we to just satisfy ourselves with statistical death rates we would not research into causes of cancer, the reliability of 737MAX flight computers, etc. Bohm took up the early work of De Broglie,
who was the first to show that material particles, like light, also show wave-like properties.

zh: 量子关系式“能量=h×频率”，使我们把一种周期现象与任何孤立的一份物质或能量联系起来。与这份物质绑定的观察者，会把它与一个由其内部能量、即“静止质量”确定的频率联系起来。对于一位观察者，若这份物质以速度
匀速运动，他就会看到这个频率因洛伦兹—爱因斯坦时间变换而降低。我已经证明（巴黎科学院《报告》，9月10日及24日），只要假定波以速度
传播，静止观察者就会始终看到这种内部周期现象与一个波同相；该波的频率由运动物体全部能量所对应的量子关系确定。这种速度大于c的波不能携带能量。
en: THE quantum relation, energy = h × frequency, leads one to associate a periodical phenomenon with any isolated portion of matter or energy. An observer bound to the portion of matter will associate with it a frequency determined by its internal energy, namely, by its ‘mass at rest.’ An observer for whom a portion of matter is in steady motion with velocity βc, will see this frequency lower in consequence of the Lorentz-Einstein time transformation. I have been able to show (Comptes rendus, September 10 and 24, of the Paris Academy of Sciences) that the fixed observer will constantly see the internal periodical phenomenon in phase with a wave the frequency of which is determined by the quantum relation using the whole energy of the moving body provided it is assumed that the wave spreads with the velocity
/β. This wave, the velocity of which is greater than
, cannot carry energy.

zh: 这种物质波特性，继爱因斯坦光电效应和相对论之后，将要求人们重新思考动力学定律在微小运动粒子上应用。
en: This wave property of matter, following on from Einstein’s photo-electric effect and relativity theories, would entail a rethinking of the laws of dynamics when applied to small moving particles.

zh: “相位波”在确定任何运动物体运动方面具有极其重要意义，我已经能够证明，玻尔原子中轨道稳定性条件表明，该波与闭合路径长度相协调。
en: The ‘phase wave’ has a very great importance in determining the motion of any moving body, and I have been able to show that the stability conditions of the trajectories in Bohr’s atom express that the wave is tuned with the length of the closed path.

zh: 当发光原子穿过狭窄孔隙时，其路径不再是直线；即发生衍射。此时必须放弃惯性原理，并假设任何运动物体始终沿着其“相位波”光线运动；这样，当它通过足够小孔隙时，其路径就会发生弯曲。动力学必须经历与光学相同演变过程——正如当波动理论取代纯几何光学时，光学所经历那样。基于波理论假设使我们能够解释干涉现象和衍射条纹。借助这些新思想，或许能够把扩散和色散现象与光离散性相协调，并解决量子理论提出几乎所有问题。
en: The path of a luminous atom is no longer straight when this atom crosses a narrow opening; that is, diffraction. It is then necessary to give up the inertia principle, and we must suppose that any moving body follows always the ray of its ‘phase wave’; its path will then bend by passing through a.sufficiently small aperture. Dynamics must undergo the same evolution that optics has undergone when undulations took the place of purely geometrical optics. Hypotheses based upon those of the wave theory allowed us to explain interferences and diffraction fringes. By means of these new ideas, it will probably be possible to reconcile also diffusion. and dispersion with the discontinuity of light, and to solve almost all the problems brought up by quanta.

zh: 在德布罗意—玻姆理论中，波方程被视为建立了一个势，其空间导数对粒子施加了一种引导力。由此产生轨迹可能以相当复杂方式弯曲。该理论数学结构非常经典，是哈密顿轨迹推广。它也是确定性。最终结果随机性源于初始粒子位置随机分布。在双缝实验中，粒子最终位置对其穿过缝隙确切位置极为敏感。引导波势会根据粒子起始点，把它们引导至截然不同最终位置。因此，在玻姆理论中，量子随机性与玻尔兹曼统计力学中原本就存在随机性并无二致。
这两种情况都假设系综中粒子初始位置是随机。
en: In the De Broglie/Bohm theory the wave equation is seen as establishing a potential, the spatial derivative of which imposes a guiding force on particles. The resultant trajectories may be curved in rather complicated ways. The mathematical structure of the theory is very classical, a generalization of Hamiltonian trajectories. It is also deterministic. Randomness of final results arises from the random spread of initial particle positions. In the two slit example, the final ending position of a particle is very sensitive to just where it passes through the aperture. The guiding wave potential steers particles to widely different final positions depending on their starting points. So, in Bohm’s account, quantum randomness is no different from the randomness that was already present in Boltzmann’s statistical mechanics.
In both cases it is assumed that the initial positions of particles in ensembles are random.

zh: SQM中的客观概率
意味着，实验结果会呈现正确的频率。然而，反过来显然并不成立。测量结果的统计分布，并不意味着存在客观概率。例如，系统系综的初始状态具有适当的统计分布，再加上适当的演化规律，也能得到这些频率。我们无法确定地预测某个光子会在屏幕的什么位置落下，只是因为不知道单个系统的初始状态。PWT采用的就是这种方法。
en: Objective probability in SQM

implies that the correct frequencies of experimental outcomes are observed. However, the reverse is obviously not true. A statistical spread of measurement outcomes does not imply the existence of objective probability. For example, these frequencies also follow from the right statistical spread in the initial state across the ensemble of systems together with the right kind of laws of evolution. The fact that we cannot predict with certainty where a particular photon will hit the screen is only due to our ignorance of the initial state of the individual system. This is the approach taken by PWT

zh: 玻姆把粒子观视为基本；而埃弗雷特或“多世界”实在论则把波函数视为基本。一切都被视为具有振幅叠加波，或者在有限模型中，被视为具有振幅状态矢量，这些振幅对应于每一个可能正交态。波函数不会发生坍缩，因为万物始终处于状态叠加之中。宇宙演化是一系列对该态矢量进行酉变换，即保持长度不变旋转。观测结果会给出确定答案；光子偏振方向会向左或向右，因为多重宇宙中与记录左偏振和右偏振相关子流形彼此正交。
en: Bohm took the particle view as fundamental; the Everett or ‘many worlds’ form of realism takes the wave function as fundamental. Everything is treated in terms of superposed waves with amplitudes, or in a finite model state vectors with amplitudes for every possible orthogonal state. There is no reduction of the wave function because everything is always in a superposition of states. The evolution of the universe is a series of unitary, that is to say, length preserving, rotations of this state vector. Observations yield definite answers; polarizations of photons go left or right, because the sub-manifolds of the multiverse associated with recording left and right polarizations are orthogonal to one another.

zh: 未来是否会有任何实验能够分出埃弗雷特和玻姆谁是正确的，我们无从知晓。目前，玻尔、海森堡、玻姆和埃弗雷特理论都与现有证据同样相容。但玻姆和埃弗雷特提出理论在解释现象方面与海森堡实证主义同样有效，这一事实表明，科学并不要求采用主观主义理论。正如我们之前所说，玻尔本人理论在原则上也与严格唯物主义相容。
en: Whether any experiments will, in the future, be able to resolve whether Everett or Bohm was right we cannot know. At present, the accounts of Bohr, Heisenberg, Bohm and Everett are all equally compatible with the evidence. But the fact that Bohm and Everett have produced theories that explain things just as well as Heisenberg’s positivism shows that science does not demand a subjectivist theory. Bohr’s own account was, as we said earlier, in principle also compatible with strict materialism.

Why? It helps to recall Heisenberg’s situation in 1955, especially the fact that the person who was Bohr’s favorite in the 1920s had become a moral exile from the Copenhagen inner circle in the postwar period, mainly because of the bitter rupture in Heisenberg’s relationship with Bohr during his ill-fated visit to Copenhagen in September 1941 after taking over the leadership of the German atomic bomb project.
